rows.gold_sql: SELECT month, signups, SUM(signups) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total FROM ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1) t
